_note: What you see: Put the timetable in your own calendar with a link you can revoke.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Het rooster in de eigen agenda zetten met een link die u kunt intrekken.
Zet dit adres in uw agenda-app om uw les: Put this address in your calendar app to see your lessons there. Your calendar app fetches it again and again, so cancelled lessons and substitutes appear by themselves.
De eerste keer staat hier alleen de knop: The first time only the button Create address is here; after that you see the address.
Iedereen met dit adres kan uw rooster le: Anyone with this address can read your timetable. Keep it to yourself.
U hebt al een agenda-adres. Bent u het k: You already have a calendar address. If you lost it or shared it by accident, create a new link: the old address then stops working.
